title: hieracium caesioides subsp. prasinops
intro: Hieracium caesioides subsp. prasinops, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. It is used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium caesioides subsp. prasinops include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its role in protecting against cell damage and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
